Get the crosswalk of grid squares to municipalities

Source: R/grid-city-get.R
grid_city_get.Rd

Returns, for each grid square, the area of it in each municipality and its share, from the administrative boundaries (行政区域, N03 of National Land Numerical Information) in force on a date. It links tables on grid squares to tables on municipalities, such as commuting flows. The first call for a release downloads its files (via ksjdata, about 370 MB) and builds the table, which takes about 45 minutes; another size of the same release reuses the work and takes minutes. The tables are then cached, and later calls take about a second.

Usage

grid_city_get(date, grid_size = "500m")

Source

Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, National Land Numerical Information, 行政区域データ (N03): https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-N03-2026.html.

Arguments

date

The date of the boundaries: a Date or a string such as "2020-10-01". The release in force on that date is used, which is the latest release with boundary_date on or before it. Use the reference date of the table to link, for example October 1 for the Population Census and January 1 for 地価公示. See grid_city_files() for the releases.

grid_size

The size of the grid squares: one of grid_sizes(), "500m" by default. Each size is built and cached for a release on its first call, without rebuilding the others.

Value

A tibble with one row per grid square and municipality:

  • boundary_date: The date of the boundaries of the release (Date).

  • release: The year of the release in National Land Numerical Information (integer).

  • grid_code: The code of the grid square (地域メッシュ・コード), with four digits for 80 km, six for 10 km, seven for 5 km, eight for 1 km, nine for 500 m, ten for 250 m, and eleven for 125 m.

  • city_code: Five-digit municipality code, as published in the release. Designated cities are split into wards. Land whose municipality is undetermined (所属未定地) is NA.

  • area_m2: The land area of the grid square in the municipality, in square meters.

  • share: The share of the land area of the grid square in the municipality. The shares of a grid square sum to one.

Details

Grid squares straddle municipal boundaries, so a square can have several rows. Areas are of land within the administrative boundaries, so squares on the coast or at the border of the country count only their land. Areas are computed on the GRS80 ellipsoid (in an Albers equal-area projection).

The first time in a session, the terms of use are shown. Published or processed data must credit the source (National Land Numerical Information, 行政区域データ, by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism), and processed data must say that they were processed.

See also

grid_code() to give points the code of their grid square.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
grid_city_get("2020-10-01")
}
